entries.english_reference: Mysterious strong winds are protecting\nFlying-type Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: De puissants vents mystérieux\nprotègent les Pokémon Vol !
entries.expected: Ventos fortes e misteriosos\nprotegem os Pokémon Voadores!

entries.source_text:
The mysterious strong winds
weakened the attack!
entries.english_reference: The mysterious strong winds\nweakened the attack!

entries.source_text:
But the extremely harsh sunlight
was not lessened at all!
entries.english_reference: But the extremely harsh sunlight\nwas not lessened at all!
entries.french_reference: Mais le soleil de plomb\nne faiblit pas !
entries.expected: Mas a luz solar extrema\nnão diminuiu nem um pouco!

entries.source_text:
But there is no relief from the
heavy rain!
entries.english_reference: But there is no relief from the\nheavy rain!
entries.french_reference: Mais la pluie battante\ncontinue de tomber !
entries.expected: Mas a chuva forte\nnão dá trégua!

entries.source_text:
But the mysterious strong winds
blow on regardless!
entries.english_reference: But the mysterious strong winds\nblow on regardless!
entries.french_reference: Mais les vents mystérieux\ncontinuent de souffler !

entries.source_text:
But the vicious sandstorm refuses
to let up!
entries.english_reference: But the vicious sandstorm refuses\nto let up!
entries.french_reference: Mais la violente tempête\nde sable continue !
entries.expected: Mas a violenta tempestade\nde areia não dá trégua!

entries.source_text:
The power of <0xFD>Û's
Fire-type moves rose!
entries.french_reference: Les capacités Feu de {B_SCR_ACTIVE_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\ngagnent en puissance !

entries.source_text:
The Ice Face took damage for
<0xFD>Œ!
entries.english_reference: The Ice Face took damage for\n<0xFD>Œ!
entries.expected: Ice Face recebeu o dano por\n<0xFD><0x10>!

entries.french_reference: La Tête de Gel de\n{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} se brise !
entries.expected: A Ice Face de\n<0xFD><0x10> se quebrou!

entries.source_text:
All screens on the field were
cleansed!
entries.english_reference: All screens on the field were\ncleansed!
entries.french_reference: Tous les murs sur le\nterrain sont dissipés !
entries.expected: Todas as barreiras do campo\nforam removidas!

entries.source_text:
The effects of Neutralizing Gas
wore off!
entries.english_reference: The effects of Neutralizing Gas\nwore off!

entries.french_reference: Les changements de stats de {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\nsont annulés !

entries.reason: Marqueur « - » partagé des descriptions réservées ; les cellules actives 0x99fd8c à 0x99fe5c le référencent (liste exhaustive dans references). Valeur conservée, sans inventer de description.

entries.source_text:
The foe is punched
with an icy fist.
It may leave the
foe with frostbite.
entries.english_reference:
Un coup de poing
glacé vient frapper
l'ennemi. Peut le
geler.
entries.expected:
Um soco de gelo
atinge o alvo.
Pode causar
congeladura.

entries.source_text:
The foe is struck
with an icy beam.
It may leave the
foe with frostbite.
entries.english_reference: Un rayon de glace\nfrappe l'ennemi. Peut\naussi le geler.
entries.french_reference:
Un rayon glacé
frappe l'ennemi.
Peut infliger une
gelure.
entries.expected:
Um raio de gelo
atinge o alvo.
Pode causar
congeladura.

entries.source_text:
A blizzard strikes
the opposing team.
It may also leave
them with frostbite.
entries.french_reference:
Une tempête de neige
frappe l'ennemi.
Peut aussi infliger
des gelures.
entries.expected:
Uma nevasca atinge
a equipe rival.
Pode causar
congeladura.

entries.source_text:
The user's body is
forced to grow,
raising the Attack
and Sp. Atk stats.
entries.french_reference:
Le corps du lanceur
pousse d'un coup.
Augmente Attaque
et Att. Spé.
entries.expected:
O corpo cresce
à força, elevando
o Ataque e o
Ataque Especial.

entries.source_text:
A simultaneous
3-beam attack that
may paralyze, burn,
or frostbite the foe.
entries.french_reference:
Triple rayon qui peut
paralyser, brûler
ou infliger des
gelures.

entries.source_text:
The opposing team is
hit with powdery snow
that may leave them
with frostbite.
entries.english_reference:
Le lanceur projette
de la neige
poudreuse. Peut aussi
geler l'ennemi.
entries.french_reference:
Neige poudreuse touche
l'équipe adverse.
Peut leur infliger
une gelure.
entries.expected:
Neve em pó atinge
a equipe rival.
Pode causar
congeladura.

entries.source_text:
An attack that frees
the user from traps
and hazards. Also
raises Speed.
entries.french_reference:
Libère le lanceur
des pièges et
dangers. Augmente
sa Vitesse.
entries.expected:
Livra o usuário de
armadilhas e
perigos. Aumenta
a Velocidade.

entries.source_text:
The user howls to
raise its team's
spirit and boost
their Attack stats.
entries.english_reference: Le lanceur hurle pour\nse rassurer, ce qui\naugmente son Attaque.
entries.french_reference:
Le lanceur hurle
pour motiver l'équipe
et booste leur
Attaque.
entries.expected:
Um uivo eleva
o ânimo e o
Ataque de toda
a equipe.

entries.source_text:
An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
entries.french_reference:
Absorbe la moitié
des dégâts infligés
pour restaurer
les PV.
entries.expected:
Absorve metade
do dano causado
para recuperar
os PS.

entries.source_text:
The foe is sliced
by a blade of air.
It may also make
the foe flinch.
entries.expected:
Uma lâmina de ar
corta o alvo.
Também pode
fazê-lo hesitar.

entries.source_text:
An almost invisibly
fast lunge that
is certain to strike
first.
entries.french_reference:
Un bond fulgurant
qui touche toujours
en priorité
frappe en premier.

entries.source_text:
The foe is attacked
with a swinging tail
as vicious as a
wave in a storm.
entries.french_reference:
Queue fouettante
déchaînée comme
une vague en furie
s'abat sur l'ennemi.
entries.expected:
Uma cauda golpeia
o alvo como uma
onda feroz em
plena tempestade.

entries.source_text:
A blast of aura
power is let loose
at the foe. It is
sure to hit.
entries.french_reference:
Une aura puissante
frappe l'ennemi.
Ne rate jamais sa
cible.
entries.expected:
Uma rajada de
aura atinge o
alvo. O ataque
nunca erra.

entries.source_text:
An attack move that
gains in intensity
if the target has
hurt the user.
entries.french_reference:
Une capacité qui
gagne en puissance
si la cible a blessé
le lanceur.
entries.expected:
O ataque fica
mais forte se o
alvo já feriu
o usuário.

entries.source_text:
The user tucks in
its wings and
charges. It also
hurts the user.
entries.french_reference:
Le lanceur replie
ses ailes et
charge. Cela le
blesse aussi.
entries.expected:
Recolhe as asas
e avança contra
o alvo. Também
fere o usuário.

entries.source_text:
The user creates a
damaging sound
wave that may lower
the foe's Sp. Def.
entries.french_reference:
Crée une onde sonore
blessante qui peut
baisser la Déf. Spé.
de l'ennemi.
entries.expected:
Uma onda sonora
fere o alvo. Pode
reduzir sua
Defesa Especial.

entries.source_text:
The user strikes
with a tough punch
that is certain to
strike first.
entries.french_reference:
Assène un poing
solide qui frappe
toujours en
premier.
entries.expected:
Um soco poderoso
que sempre
atinge o alvo
primeiro.

entries.source_text:
The user fires a
load of electricity
that may raise the
user's Sp. Atk.
entries.french_reference:
Envoie une salve
d'électricité qui peut
monter l'Att. Spé.
du lanceur.
entries.expected:
Uma descarga
elétrica pode
aumentar o próprio
Ataque Especial.

entries.source_text:
The foe is fought
up close. This cuts
the user's Defense
and Sp. Def stats.
entries.french_reference:
Corps à corps brutal.
Baisse la Défense
et la Déf. Spé.
du lanceur.
entries.expected:
Luta corpo a corpo
que reduz a Defesa
e a Defesa Especial
do usuário.

entries.source_text:
An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
poison the foe.
entries.expected:
Alta chance de
acerto crítico.
Também pode
envenenar o alvo.

entries.source_text:
The user releases
a horrible aura that
may also make the
foe flinch.
entries.expected:
Uma aura horrível
atinge o alvo.
Também pode
fazê-lo hesitar.

entries.source_text:
The user looses an
electric flare that
hits all Pokémon
and may paralyze.
entries.french_reference:
Lance une gerbe
électrique qui touche
tous les Pokémon
et peut paralyser.
entries.expected:
Uma descarga atinge
todos os Pokémon.
Também pode
paralisar.

entries.source_text:
An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user's
Sp. Atk stat.
entries.french_reference:
Attaque intense qui
fait chuter beaucoup
l'Att. Spé. du
lanceur.
entries.expected:
Um ataque intenso
que reduz muito
o Ataque Especial
do usuário.

entries.source_text:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave
generated by the
user's gaping mouth.
entries.french_reference:
Une onde de choc
frappe l'ennemi,
venue de la
large bouche du lanceur.
entries.expected:
Uma onda de choque
sai da boca aberta
do usuário e
atinge o alvo.

entries.source_text:
A harsh punch that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
entries.french_reference:
Un coup violent qui
vole la moitié des
dégâts pour rendre
des PV.
entries.expected:
Um soco absorve
metade do dano
causado para
recuperar PS.

entries.source_text:
The ground under the
foe erupts. It may
also lower the foe's
Sp. Def.
entries.french_reference:
Le sol explose sous
l'ennemi. Peut aussi
baisser la Déf. Spé.
de l'ennemi.
entries.expected:
O chão sob o alvo
entra em erupção.
Pode reduzir sua
Defesa Especial.

entries.source_text:
The foe is blasted
with natural energy.
It may also lower
the foe's Sp. Def.
entries.french_reference:
Énergie naturelle
frappe l'ennemi.
Peut aussi baisser
sa Déf. Spé.
entries.expected:
Energia natural
atinge o alvo.
Pode reduzir sua
Defesa Especial.

entries.source_text:
The user unleashes
its power. It may
also lower the
foe's Sp. Def.
entries.french_reference:
Le lanceur déchaîne
sa puissance. Peut
aussi baisser la
Déf. Spé. ennemie.
entries.expected:
Libera seu poder
contra o alvo.
Pode reduzir sua
Defesa Especial.

entries.source_text:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave
that may also leave
it paralyzed.
entries.english_reference:
Une onde de choc
frappe l'ennemi. Peut
aussi paralyser la
cible.
entries.french_reference:
Une onde de choc
frappe l'ennemi.
Peut aussi le
paralyser.
entries.expected:
Uma onda de choque
atinge o alvo.
Também pode
paralisá-lo.

entries.source_text:
A severely damaging
attack that makes
the user rest on
the next turn.
entries.french_reference:
Attaque très puissante
qui force le lanceur
à se reposer
au tour suivant.
entries.expected:
Um ataque potente
que exige descanso
do usuário no
próximo turno.

entries.source_text:
Grass snares and
trips the foe. It
does more damage
to heavier foes.
entries.french_reference:
L'herbe piège et
fait trébucher
l'ennemi. Plus il
est lourd, plus ça fait mal.
entries.expected:
Grama prende e
derruba o alvo.
Quanto mais pesa,
maior o dano.

entries.source_text:
Filthy garbage is
shot at the foe.
It may also poison
the target.
entries.french_reference:
Un tas d'ordures
est lancé. Peut aussi
empoisonner
l'adversaire.
entries.expected:
Lixo imundo é
lançado no alvo.
Também pode
envenená-lo.

entries.source_text:
The user swings
its heavy fist.
It also lowers the
user's Speed.
entries.french_reference:
Balance un poing
lourd. Baisse aussi
la Vitesse du
lanceur.
entries.expected:
Golpeia com um
punho pesado.
Também reduz a
própria Velocidade.

entries.source_text:
A reckless, life-
risking tackle that
also hurts the user
terribly.
entries.expected:
Uma investida
arriscada que
também fere muito
o usuário.

entries.source_text:
The user hurls
chunks of ice
that are certain to
strike first.
entries.french_reference:
Lance des blocs
de glace. Frappe
toujours en
premier.

entries.source_text:
The foe is slammed
with its hard head.
It may also make
the foe flinch.
entries.expected:
Uma cabeçada
forte atinge o
alvo. Pode
fazê-lo hesitar.

entries.source_text:
Scarlet flames wash
over all Pokémon in
battle. It may also
inflict burns.
entries.french_reference:
Des flammes écarlates
balayent le combat.
Peut aussi
brûler.
entries.expected:
Chamas escarlates
atingem todos os
Pokémon. Também
podem queimar.

entries.source_text:
A steel bomb is
stuck to the foe.
It is sure to hit.
entries.french_reference: Une bombe d'acier\ncolle à l'ennemi.\nNe rate jamais sa cible.
entries.expected:
Uma bomba de aço
é presa ao alvo.
O ataque nunca
erra.

entries.source_text:
The foe is struck
with a mud ball
that may also lower
its accuracy.
entries.french_reference:
Une boule de boue
frappe et peut
aussi baisser la
Précision.
entries.expected:
Uma bola de lama
atinge o alvo.
Pode reduzir
sua Precisão.

entries.source_text:
The user thinks
bad thoughts. It
sharply raises the
Sp. Atk stat.
